tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: inno-optimize is a proactive architecture & intelligence optimization system for business systems, agents, and automation.

tour.title: Core Packages
tour.description: The core packages provide the foundation: agentdb, mcp-framework, adr-automation, ast-analysis.

tour.title: Intelligence Layer
tour.description: The intelligence layer provides SONA, ReasoningBank, MoE Router, and EWC++ consolidation.

tour.title: Coordination Layer
tour.description: The coordination layer provides HiveMind Swarm, Saga Orchestrator, Pheromone Scheduler, and Business MCP Servers.

tour.title: Optimization Layer
tour.description: The optimization layer provides OAPEL cycles, A/B Testing, Regression Detection, Flywheel Evaluation, and Templates.
